# Lichinga OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

Municipality outreach package for **Lichinga, Mozambique**. Figures are
screening outputs for discussion, not a bid, endorsement or construction release.

## Audience

- Office of the Mayor or city executive for Lichinga
- Lichinga municipal transport and urban-planning authority
- Lichinga climate, energy or sustainability office
- Lichinga municipal finance and investment unit

## Local proposition

| Measure | Current planning result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 250,000 |
| Lines / route length | 2 / 14.9 km |
| Line-platform stops / fleet | 8 / 34 trainsets |
| Practical capacity ceiling | 178,560 passenger-trips/day |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 7.1 MW / 43.5 MWh |
| City programme CAPEX | $151 M |
| Local capital and value share | $119 M (79%) |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $240 M |
| Annual OPEX planning value | $4 M |

Lead with locally buildable infrastructure, open design review, renewable-energy
integration and a staged feasibility process. Do not lead with the comparator;
it is an illustrative sensitivity, not a vendor quotation.

## Call to action

Ask for a 30-minute technical review, nomination of a municipal counterpart,
access to current mobility/land/utility data, and agreement on the scope of an
independent feasibility study. Verify the recipient in
[`contact-research.csv`](../../../../contact-research.csv)
before sending.
